text: The pension scheme is open to all citizens aged 18 to 40 years who hold a savings bank account. Income tax payers are not eligible to join the scheme.
Monthly pension under this component shall be payable to widows aged 40 to 79 years. The applicant must belong to a household Below Poverty Line as per the criteria prescribed by the Government.
Aids and assistive devices shall be provided to persons with 40% or more disability. The annual family income of the applicant should be not exceeding Rs 3.6 lakh.
The scheme is applicable to residents of Madhya Pradesh. Women aged 21 to 60 years with an annual family income not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh may apply. Income tax payers are not eligible.
Persons aged 60 years or above shall be entitled to a monthly pension. Only applicants from families Below Poverty Line shall be considered.

Scholarships under this scheme are awarded to students belonging to Scheduled Castes for studies beyond the matriculation stage. The annual family income of the student should be not exceeding Rs 2.5 lakh.

Financial assistance for construction of a house is extended to houseless families living in rural areas. Applicants should have an annual family income not exceeding Rs 1.8 lakh. Income tax payers are not eligible.

Composite loans for setting up new enterprises are available to entrepreneurs belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. Applicants must be aged 18 years or above on the date of application.
A deposit-free cooking gas connection is released in the name of adult women from households Below Poverty Line. The benefit is restricted to residents of Uttar Pradesh.
Girls aged 10 to 18 years who are residents of Bihar are eligible for the incentive. The amount is transferred only to a savings bank account held in the name of the beneficiary.
